thread:
Maria (CS): Heads-up: AcmeCorp expects a steeper ramp next Tuesday during their marketing push. Estimated demand looks like it could breach their committed Dedicated quota by ~35%. We need a lightweight mitigation plan: autoscale guardrails, temporary burst capacity, a short load validation, and an explicit rollback/runbook. Volunteers?

Jordan (Eng): I'll take the autoscale config + fallback model policy. Thinking conservative ramp: scale when p95 > 300ms, cap burst at +40% reserved. I'll draft YAML and open a PR against infra-config.

Kevin (Infra): I can provision burst capacity but billing needs to OK temporary headroom. Need exact quota ID + window. Also note zone affinity may affect where slots come from.

Maria (CS): Quota ID: ACME-2026-Q3. Planned window: Tue 09:00-12:00 PT (with setup 08:30). Looped in @finance-rep.

Lee (SRE): I'll author the rollback/runbook and include the pager matrix. Quick rollback pattern: shift traffic off the Dedicated pool, disable the autoscale ramp, and failover to Hosted endpoint if needed. I'll add a chaos probe to verify fallbacks.

Natalie (PDE): I'll own the load test. Plan: 30-minute soak starting at 09:30 PT. Profile: 10k RPS peak, ~60% long-gen requests, 40% short inferences. Using loadgen: 
```bash
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 200 --rps 10000 --profile profiles/acme-longtail.json \
  --auth "Bearer $ACME_TOKEN" --duration 1800
```
I'll capture error traces, KV cache hit rate, and latency histograms and post artifacts here.

Jordan (Eng): Draft autoscale config (will PR):
```yaml
autoscale:
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  scale_up_threshold: 300
  scale_down_threshold: 150
  cool_down: 120s
  max_burst_percent: 40
  fallback_model: gptx-small-quant
```
Will include alerts for error-rate and queue-length. Tagging @Kevin and @Lee for validation.

ops-bot: Job created -> load-test-acme-1719010200. CI link: https://ci.internal/steps/lt-acme-1719010200 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kevin (Infra): Billing approved provisional burst Tue 08:30-13:00 PT. I'll provision slots and publish slot IDs today. Note: zone mapping might place some slots in us-west-2a.

Lee (SRE): Runbook draft: https://confluence.internal/acme/dedicated-scarcity-mitigation. Includes prechecks, rollback commands, and paging sequence. Adding chaos probe to validate fallback model works under simulated failures.

Maria (CS): Quick owner recap and due dates: Jordan -> PR for autoscale + fallback (EOD today); Kevin -> provision burst + slot IDs (EOD today); Natalie -> load script + run Tue 09:30 PT and post results; Lee -> finalize runbook + chaos probe (Mon EOD); Maria -> customer comms and renewal note to Renewals team. If anything slips we delay ramp.

Jordan (Eng): I'll instrument the autoscale PR with the metrics we should watch: p95 latency, 5xx error rate, tail queue length, and cost-per-token estimate for the window.

Natalie (PDE): I'll also include a tiny sampler that logs KV cache hit rates and a quick script to replay failing payloads for debugging.

Maria (CS): Also requesting Renewals to pause auto-renew until we can validate capacity headroom. Renewal risk currently medium if we can't demonstrate a stable ramp.

Kevin (Infra): Provisioned slot (provisioned-ACME-burst-01). I'll confirm zone mapping and any constraints by EOD. Billing will flag charges to the account team.

Lee (SRE): Adding the rollback snippet to runbook for quick ops:
```bash
# re-route traffic away from Dedicated pool
redwood route update --customer acme --pool default
# disable autoscale ramp for customer
redwood autoscale update --customer acme --enabled false
```
I'll also add commands to repro the fallback locally.

Maria (CS): Great. Meeting to confirm go/no-go Mon 16:00 PT. If PRs + artifacts look good I'll send AcmeCorp an official confirmation of the ramp and include the runbook excerpt. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (Eng): +1 :thumbsup:

Natalie (PDE): +1, will post artifacts here after staging run and shadow test.

ops-bot: Reminder created -> load-test-acme scheduled to start in 24h (job id 1719010200).

Maria (CS): Final note: log any anomalies to ticket ACME-1234 and escalate to #incidents if error-rate spikes or latencies breach SLA.
